summary: Tested the DONATIONS_ENABLED=false feature-hide change on app/success.tsx. Backend (pytest): 2/2 new tests passed confirming POST /api/manifestations/{id}/manifested correctly accepts and persists donation_amount=0 (donated=False) and testimony. Frontend (Playwright, mobile viewport 375x667, real backend via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, dev-login as test@mtree.dev): confirmed the donation tier chips (success-donation-tier-*) and 'Donate & Continue' button (success-donate) are completely absent from the DOM on the success screen; only testimony input (success-testimony) + single 'Continue ✦' button (success-skip-donation) render. Stepper correctly reads 'Reflect' -> 'Share' (no 'Donation' label anywhere on page). Tapping Continue (using mouse down/up since FilledButton uses onPressIn, not onPress/click) fired POST /manifestations/{id}/manifested with donation_amount:0, got 200, advanced the stepper (Reflect marked done with checkmark) to the Share step, and the entered testimony correctly appeared on the rendered AchievementCard. Regression sanity pass: Home screen (Set Goal/Set Sacrifice CTA after manifesting), Community Wall (shows public entries with Donated:No/Yes badges - unrelated pre-existing feature, works fine), Settings screen (Account/Deity/Reminder Center/Daily Streak Reminder toggle all render and toggle correctly) - no regressions found from this change.
action_items: No blocking issues found. The DONATIONS_ENABLED=false flag correctly hides all donation-collection UI (tier chips + Donate button) on success.tsx while the skip/finalize flow (donation_amount=0) continues to work end-to-end exactly as before.

Confirmed as expected/pre-existing and NOT part of this change: paywall.tsx auto-grants premium on signup (no real Google Play Billing) - test user showed is_premium:true immediately after dev-login, matching the flagged mocked_api note.

Community Wall still displays a 'Donated: Yes/No' badge on public entries (pre-existing, unrelated to this hide-flag) - harmless since it just reflects historical donation_amount data, no new donations can be made now that the UI is hidden.
critical_code_review_comments: success.tsx: DONATIONS_ENABLED flag cleanly gates both the Card/tier-grid JSX and swaps the FilledButton+GhostButton pair for a single FilledButton — no dead code paths left rendering when disabled, well-scoped single-flag toggle for easy re-enable later.
Stepper label correctly derived from the same flag (DONATIONS_ENABLED ? 'Donation' : 'Reflect') so there's no separate hardcoded string to keep in sync.
skipDonation()/finalize(0) path unchanged from before the flag was added - zero risk of breaking the underlying manifested-with-zero-donation flow, confirmed via direct backend test.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - donation UI hidden as expected, skip/finalize flow works, no regressions in Home/Wall/Settings

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed manifestations for test@mtree.dev via dev-login during testing (goal_custom: TEST_UI_goal*, TEST_goal_donation_hide) - these are excluded from the public Community Wall automatically since @mtree.dev accounts are always is_public:false server-side; safe to leave or clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For success.tsx testing: FilledButton/GhostButton in src/components/ui.tsx use onPressIn (not onPress/click) as a documented Reanimated New-Arch workaround - Playwright must use mouse.move()+mouse.down()+wait+mouse.up() on the button's bounding box, plain .click(force=True) does NOT fire the handler (confirmed: 3 attempts with .click() produced zero network calls to /manifested, while the mouse-down/up sequence worked immediately). To reach success.tsx directly for testing: dev-login -> PATCH /api/profile with deity_id + onboarding_done/profile_done/tour_done true -> POST /api/manifestations (requires sacrifice_category field, easily missed) -> set localStorage key 'mtree_session_token' (JSON-stringified token) -> goto /success?id=<mid>.
rca_of_issue: N/A - this was a verification of a clean feature-flag hide, not a bug fix. No RCA needed; both the UI-hide and underlying finalize flow work as designed.
